post.text: The last Magic Tree House, “Revolutionary War on Wednesday,” was released on September 26, 2000. https://t.co/plwmvCQh9t
post.author_description: Live-posting as a reporter embedded in history. Curated by @MannyMarotta. Companion to @50YearsAgoLive, @100YearsAgoLive, and @250YearsAgoLive. DM for business.

description.description: The image shows the front cover of the book 'Revolutionary War on Wednesday', which is the 22nd book in the Magic Tree House series by Mary Pope Osborne. The illustration depicts George Washington and several children on a boat crossing an icy river, evocative of Washington's crossing of the Delaware. Washington stands tall at the front with a sword, while a young boy holds a large American flag behind him. Other children are huddled in the boat amidst falling snow.
description.ocrText: MAGIC TREE HOUSE #22 Revolutionary War on Wednesday Mary Pope Osborne
